CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.onestep_reserve_photo(p_date date)
 RETURNS onestep_photos
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid := onestep_private.require_user(); photo uuid := gen_random_uuid(); result public.onestep_photos;
begin
  perform onestep_private.ensure_garden(u);
  -- The composite FK requires an existing record belonging to this account.
  insert into public.onestep_photos(user_id,id,record_date,object_path)
    values(u,photo,p_date,u::text || '/' || photo::text || '.jpg') returning * into result;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.require_user()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if u is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  return u;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin perform onestep_private.ensure_garden(new.id); return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.today(u uuid)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (now() at time zone timezone)::date from public.onestep_profiles where user_id = u
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.onestep_ensure_garden()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin perform onestep_private.ensure_garden(onestep_private.require_user()); end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION onestep_private.photo_access(path text, operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and exists (
    select 1 from public.onestep_photos p where p.user_id = auth.uid() and p.object_path = path
      and (operation = 'read' or (operation = 'upload' and p.status = 'staged') or (operation = 'delete' and p.status = 'retired'))
  )
$function$
